risks.description: A user-facing immigration claim is presented without source-confirmed official evidence.
risks.mitigation: Require Source Evidence Auditor review and downgrade unsupported claims to unresolved or unavailable.

risks.description: Production visa/status data is edited without all required gates and human approval.
risks.mitigation: Enforce Source Evidence Auditor approval, Data Update Planner plan, Regression & Test pass, Risk Chair GO, and human approval.

risks.description: AI answer overstates eligibility, approval likelihood, or automatic status change.
risks.mitigation: Run Answer Quality review and maintain regression cases for overconfident claims.

risks.description: UI blurs required documents, procedure timeline, AI explanation, and source/evidence block.
risks.mitigation: Require UX/UI Audit review and UI smoke tests for affected flows.

risks.description: Localized text changes legal or administrative meaning or hides uncertainty.
risks.mitigation: Require Translation & Localization QA review and glossary regression cases.

risks.description: Known source, answer, search, UI, or translation regressions are not re-run before release.
risks.mitigation: Require Regression & Test report before Risk Chair final review.

risks.description: Operational decisions or unresolved issues remain only in Slack and are forgotten.
risks.mitigation: Require GitHub Issue, PR, report, or file writeback for every important task state and decision.
